notes.title: Farm Supply Simulator 25 Demo: Maintenance Update
notes.content: [h2][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h2][h3][b]Thank you for playing the Farm Supply Simulator 25 Demo.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Improvements made in this update:[/p][list][*][p]The disposal limit for small trash bins has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented boxes from being saved in their correct positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain market products could break the checkout system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where only the product image remained on the shelf label after the item ran out.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where customer warning messages sometimes appeared above their heads by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization issues with the names of market and storage shelves.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some boxes could not display their outline.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the storage shelf kept sliding downward in placement mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the storage shelf outline did not appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Integrated the land unlocking system into the storage area.[/p][/*][*][p]Added signs to the entrances of the storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Rent and electricity bill costs have been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers could walk through shelves in the market.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where customers sometimes got stuck in place in the market.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor disappeared when clicking on the 3-hopper chemical fertilizer machine.[/p][/*][*][p]The saved games panel in the main menu has been completely redesigned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the storage shelf outline remained active after restarting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]One achievement has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where product prices did not fit properly in the basket tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the box image to disappear in the basket tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the product quantity inside boxes was displayed incorrectly in the basket tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused stuttering in the tutorial panel.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][i]If you encounter any issues or problems, please reach out to us through our Discord or Steam community. Your feedback is crucial for us to resolve issues quickly. [/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.content: [h2][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h2][h3][b]Thank you for playing the Farm Supply Simulator 25 Demo.[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]You can now automatically add products to a pallet by holding down when standing next to it, if it contains matching items.[/p][/*][*][p]Market baskets have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers turned in the wrong direction when taking a basket.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a pallet could not be reused after delivering products from it.[/p][/*][*][p]The computer has been removed and replaced with a digital screen that can be opened with the [b]TAB key[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial translations have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]4 new product licenses have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]1 new chemical fertilizer license has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]20 new products have been added to the market.[/p][/*][*][p]1 new 3-hopper chemical fertilizer machine has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The map has been completely redesigned.[/p][/*][*][p]The forklift’s headlights have been remodeled and replaced.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where boundary lines were not visible while moving trash bins.[/p][/*][*][p]All product images have been replaced with new ones.[/p][/*][*][p]The money display at the top-right corner now features increase/decrease animations when earning or spending money.[/p][/*][*][p]Different product types now arrive in different box styles.[/p][/*][*][p]A sound effect has been added when picking up any object.[/p][/*][*][p]A throwing sound effect has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers could not take products from a shelf while it was in move mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers could not recognize a shelf after it was moved to storage and placed again.[/p][/*][*][p]Added payment sound effects to certain checkout areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the outline bug when opening trash bins.[/p][/*][*][p]New types of organic fertilizers can now be produced.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved LOD optimizations for several objects.[/p][/*][*][p]The farm dog has been added; you can play with it and make it follow you.[/p][/*][*][p]Economic balance adjustments have been made to product buying and selling prices.[/p][/*][*][p]The price input screen’s slider has been removed and replaced with an input field.[/p][/*][*][p]A land unlocking system has been added; separate areas for market and production can now be created.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the market worker could not throw away empty boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notification to inform the player when a trash bin is full.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]If you encounter any issues or problems, please reach out to us through our Discord or Steam community. Your feedback is crucial for us to resolve issues quickly. [/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Farm Supply Simulator 25 – The Biggest Farm Update Yet!
notes.content: [h2][b]Hello Farmers! 👋[/b][/h2][p]The most comprehensive update we’ve been working on for Farm Supply Simulator 25 is almost ready! With this update, your farm won’t just grow — it will also become much more lively and realistic. We’ve taken your feedback into account and added many new features that make farming both more fun and much deeper to manage.[/p][p]Let’s take a look at what’s coming:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐕 Farm Dog – Your Loyal Companion[/b][/h3][p]You’re no longer alone on your farm! Your loyal farm dog is here to accompany you every step of the way.[/p][list][*][p]Interact with your dog and give commands such as [i]Sit[/i], [i]Follow[/i], [i]Go Home[/i], and [i]Play[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Throw a bone, spend time together, and bring warmth to your farm life.[/p][/*][*][p]Not just an animal, but a true friend![/p][/*][/list][p]This feature will make your farm feel more cozy and alive — we believe it’ll be simply indispensable. 🐶[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/cb2f29eb16c6e3a4245e9dd1922d1ba82f3a89b0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/ba9e122f2e5dd2eb503df8b40a4e4784e423a024.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/545920690d8d2c3673ca7b28a281ba1d607d1eb0.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]⚙️5 New Machines for Fertilizer Production[/b][/h3][p]Great news for those who want to expand their fertilizer production line:[/p][list][*][p]5 brand-new fertilizer production machines have been added to the game. [i](In the demo version, there will be fewer.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]They offer more efficient, faster, and more diverse production opportunities.[/p][/*][*][p]The most important pillar of your farm’s economy is now stronger than ever.[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s the perfect time to expand your production line and grow your farm! 🌱[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/b5284ea6a28810d4c935257e3f62c2b63bbd605e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/03fb5b15e934bfb901af9a18bc98723e4e2b2f39.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/2b6a2c75dc10c8c288aa73a4caac9f208db0abea.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/39d737e51a2c487ea74dab37a68a25d128dbddf3.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🌍 A Brand-New Map[/b][/h3][p]One of the most exciting parts of the big update is the brand-new map![/p][list][*][p]A larger, more detailed, and much more fun area is waiting for you to explore.[/p][/*][*][p]With wind turbines, water towers, vast fields, and new farm roads, the atmosphere feels more realistic than ever.[/p][/*][*][p]With these new regions, gameplay will become richer and more long-lasting.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/b9fc8ad9af34224644ebf9866b8ccc5da9a99a25.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/77202e1056d348b0a8c08912777e43b4d4b85558.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/7acbd7eb4092e0628a01bcb7c6684b880bdafbe0.png"][/img][/p][h3]🧪 [b]Soil Analysis Laboratory – Scientific Farming[/b][/h3][p]A farm requires not only hard work, but also [b]science[/b]![/p][list][*][p]With the new soil analysis laboratory, you’ll be able to examine the condition of your customers’ soil.[/p][/*][*][p]Based on the results, you’ll recommend treatments and work to maximize soil fertility.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/65575e60234d7d2fae6323295db09f5e5f0553ca.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🛒 Over 70 New Market Products[/b][/h3][p]Your market shelves will no longer look empty![/p][list][*][p]More than [b]70 new products[/b] will be available for sale in the markets.[/p][/*][*][p]The fuller your shelves, the fuller your farm’s cash register will be.[/p][/*][*][p]In the demo version there will be fewer products, but in the full release you can expect a massive market experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to the new product variety, developing sales strategies will now be more fun than ever![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/e82b166678e6d9fa21e98233e064c455c3967c36.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/ec7df52d13b0585ea1436140725a956d3f90f0cc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652720/abf3f458a1a7e8c6153a27431da72c89a15e1283.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Farm Supply Simulator 25 is growing and evolving every single day. With this update, you won’t just be growing and selling products anymore — you’ll be turning your farm into a true living space.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Spend time with your loyal dog, raise your animals, produce with machines; stock up your market and sell with your cashier; analyze the soil with your laboratory. And on top of all that, explore everything on a brand-new map. 🚜🌾[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Get ready, farmers — because this isn’t just an update, it’s a new beginning for your farm life! 🙌[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.0.1.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h2][h3][b]Thank you for playing the Farm Supply Simulator 25 Demo.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]New features added in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where item counts inside boxes were not visible after loading the game.,[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected errors in the end-of-day panel that caused statistics to display incorrectly and text misalignment.,[/p][/*][*][p]Ensured the forklift steering wheel remains correctly positioned during turns.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added new informational panels inside the forklift.,[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where players could clip into pallets and be launched into the air.,[/p][/*][*][p]Installed an invisible wall between the production area and the sales hangar.,[/p][/*][*][p]Applied various UI enhancements to the machine control panel.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented outline lighting on objects produced by the machine.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash issue that occurred after purchasing the blood bottle required for production machines.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the fish waste bag was placed incorrectly in the box.,[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved the problem where the object inside the large box was not displaying its image and information.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization errors in the bill panel.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the remaining days text on bill panels was not updating.,[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the incorrect payment amount display in the job offers panel.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where objects placed into the machine would fall. Now, after placing an item into the machine, it automatically turns into a trash bag.,[/p][/*][*][p]A notification is now displayed at the end of the day.,[/p][/*][*][p]Access to the plant guide panel on the computer has been enabled.,[/p][/*][*][p]Minor UI improvements have been made throughout various areas.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a localization error in the notification panel that appeared when selling a product without entering a price.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed freezing issues in some tutorial panels.,[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved the problem where the counter in the customer service tutorial would reset after exiting and re-entering the game.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues where the player could fall through the ground in certain areas of the map.[/p][/*][*][p]The issue causing multiple instances to appear after hiring a cashier has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]If you encounter any issues or problems, please reach out to us through our Discord or Steam community. Your feedback is crucial for us to resolve issues quickly.
[/i][/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.0.1.1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h2][h3][b]Thank you for playing the Farm Supply Simulator 25 Demo.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]New features added in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed players to move objects while holding a box.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the mouse cursor disappeared after exiting the computer.[/p][/*][*][p]A notification panel now appears when the save game button is pressed, confirming successful save.[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction hints are now shown in the info panel when looking at the cashier seat with the crosshair, both before and after sitting.[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction options are now displayed in the info panel when looking at the trash bin.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed texts that remained in a single language on the end-of-day screen; multi-language support has been applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Minimized the issue where the player's camera could clip through objects and see outside the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where purchased boxes appeared in the wrong position after reloading the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed players to pass through certain walls inside the market building.[/p][/*][*][p]Added invisible boundary blocks to prevent players from leaving the game world.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][i][b]If you encounter any issues or problems, please reach out to us through our Discord or Steam community. Your feedback is crucial for us to resolve issues quickly.
[/b][/i][/p][p][/p]
